art_direction: 鼠尾草信封 · 有点期待: 雾绿底，奶白信封翻起珊瑚色小封口，露出期待眼神。
composition_variation: A small cream-white envelope brought to life on a smooth muted sage-green field. Rounded rectangular envelope body at a gentle tilt, one lifted triangular flap with a restrained warm coral inner face, forming a single coherent silhouette. Only two subtle fold lines where needed, no realistic paper texture. Two tiny charcoal eyes on the front panel look toward the raised flap with a quietly expectant expression; one minute curved mouth. No stamps, letters, text, hearts or contents sticking out. Off-white, sage, coral and charcoal only. Envelope roughly 61 percent width, centered with generous blank space and a simple memorable silhouette. Charming private little message spirit, no arms or legs.
style_inspiration: Continuing the established minimalist flat-color avatar collection, with newly invented everyday-object characters, restrained palette and generous negative space. Text-only generation; no source or generated image was supplied as binary model input.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected; distinct original object character, readable silhouette, restrained flat palette, no visible text or watermark
